content: Broader industry discussions have consistently highlighted the importance of leveraging South Africa's existing resources, particularly its expanding data centers, to support intensive AI advancements [162] . For Vcom, these data centers provide the essential computational power required by YAL.ai’s algorithms to process vast amounts of network traffic data in real time. Moreover, the telecommunications sector is increasingly exploring the concept of AI Native Networks (AINN), wherein artificial intelligence fundamentally powers the initial design and continuous operation of communication systems [162] . While these frameworks remain largely conceptual in their broadest nationwide applications, the Vcom and YAL.ai initiative represents a practical, localized application of AINN principles, specifically tailored to optimize network security and data integrity.
